site_name: QTS Fort Worth (former Health Care Service Corp 'CDC2' data center), 14100 Park Vista Blvd, Fort Worth, TX 76177
verification: Not verified: two government records for this address point to different years and neither states when the data center began operating. (1) The cited TDLR record is real and matches the address and facility name, but it is a 'CONFERENCE/ TRAINING INTERIOR FINISH-OUT' of two rooms (~1,475 sq ft, $110,000, type 'Renovation/Alteration'), start 11/1/2009, completion 1/1/2010, 'Project Closed'. It dates an interior room fit-out, not the data center's commissioning, and a 1 January completion date sits on the 2009/2010 boundary. (2) The Tarrant Appraisal District page for 14100 Park Vista Blvd (account 43259149, opened by me, not in the research record) reads 'Year Built: 2008', 100% complete, 261,836 sq ft. This is an assessor year-built record that would nominally qualify as medium evidence for 2008, not 2010, but I am not reporting 2008 as verified: this is inference, not verified, but the Data Center Knowledge URL slug dated 2008/07/23 describes the project as 'planned', which makes an operating 260,000 sq ft data center in 2008 implausible; 2008 more likely reflects construction start or the first roll year. (3) The Data Center Knowledge 2008 URL now resolves to a generic archive index, so the reported 'Q1 2010 completion / May 2010 computer installs' schedule could not be opened or confirmed (and would be a plan in any case). (4) The QTS 30 Jan 2017 release confirms an existing facility with 'HCSC will remain an anchor tenant in the facility with a one megawatt lease' but states no build or opening year. (5) QTS's Fort Worth page gives the address but no opening date. Unavailable to automated fetch: web.archive.org, datacenterdynamics.com (403), bizjournals.com, star-telegram.com, dallasnews.com (page failed to load). The start year is most likely in the 2009-2010 range (inference from the TDLR fit-out timing), but no opened page supports a single year at the required standard. If the study accepts assessor year-built at face value, the supported year would be 2008, not the claimed 2010; I recommend a human review before using either.
